process_library_download_chunks: process a single library by downloading, extracting, and chunking all its markdown documentation files
process_all_libraries_download_chunks: process all HuggingFace library documentation by downloading, extracting, and chunking markdown files into excerpts
save_chunks_to_json: save processed documentation chunks to a JSON file with text, URLs, titles, headings, and package metadata
get_latest_version_zip: query the HuggingFace dataset API to find the latest versioned zip file for a library
fetch_library_directories: fetch the list of available library directories from the HuggingFace doc-build dataset API
